summary: test55 projects away 1024 private continuous y columns (x<=480y plus 1 or 3 links y<=u) from a 3872-var/3904-row MIP and rewrites the 1536 incident rows as x<=M u, with M certified per block from a capacity row (a_x*M+sum a_u=B, giving 120/338/348, else 480). The delivered kernel proof is 3.6 MB of purely v2 primitives (2560 Cases, 2560 EqPair and 7680 Lin in the forward claim, 5120 Lin in the two reverse claims, 6656 top steps over 3 claims) and verifies in 0.093 s using 674,339 work units of the 1e9 default budget - the cost is entirely on the construction side. The 120-line preparer hand-writes the coordinate projection, the per-link Cases expansion, the claim flags and the text writer; both of the agent's only two failed calls were its own wrong assumptions (an MPS integer-bound semantic, and a link-count guess), each of which one typed query would have refuted before any code ran.
claims: 3 claims, objective Equal on all, inverse null on all: claim 0 forward (reverse=false) projects the 3872 source variables onto the 2848 target variables; claims 1 and 2 reverse (input_integers=output_integers=true, then false) map the target back with y := x/480.

Retained coordinates are bound explicitly: 2848 [source,target] pairs per claim (8544 total), all identity by index; the 1024 removed y are deliberately not bijected - the lift is the single-valued completion y=x/480, so no inverse map is claimed.

512 of 1024 blocks get a lowered activation bound (M=120 for the 256 one-link blocks; M=338/348 for the 256 three-link blocks) that uses binary integrality, so this is mixed-integer projection only; claim 2 (integrality off) carries the weaker LP inclusion.

Each lowered bound has a local capacity witness: a_x*M + sum over the linked u of a_u = B on a nonnegative L row (C___0401: 400-(40+20+2)=338), with all other terms only required nonnegative; no global bound or strictness is claimed.
Everything else is preserved: 1280 equalities, RHS vector, all 288 explicit binary bounds, integrality markers and the COST____ objective are unchanged; only the MPS NAME moves test55 -> test55R.
proof_encoding: File text is the line 'RPA 2' plus one JSON object {claims:[3], blocks:[3]}: capability version 2, i.e. EqPair and local Cases only (docs/CURRENT_FORMAT.md:369); no Flow/Interval/Menu/Signed/Point rule is used.

Claim 0 forward: 1536 top-level steps, nested Cases trees = 2560 Cases + 2560 EqPair + 7680 Lin (2560 branches reported by verify); end.Return{map: 2848 identity expressions, checks: 9153}. Each Cases carries kind Le, the wanted target inequality, split u<=1, integer {"VarInt":u}, a zero branch (Lin over RowUpper of VUB + link + {"Assumption":0}) and a one branch that EqPairs {"VarUpper":u} with the assumption.

Claims 1-2 reverse: 2560 Lin steps each, no Cases; end.Return{map: 3872 expressions = 2848 identities + 1024 y := x/480, checks: 11201 and 10913}. Claim 1's Lin terms for a removed y prove VarLower(y) scaled by 1/480; claim 2 is the same block without VarInt facts.

The request file is exactly the claims array (96209 bytes, written by tools/prepare_test24.py:161); every obligation is a raw RowUpper/VarLower/VarUpper/VarInt/RowEq/Local ref, and the 1536 'Local' checks re-expose the forward steps as obligations.

Verified sizes and cost: proof.rpa 3,772,500 B, proof.rpx 2,539,023 B, assemble 71,852 us, verify execute 92,658 us with work 674,339, obligations 31,267, peak_live_facts 2560, substitution_terms 36,880, linear_terms 82,432; preparation 2.38 s total.
agent_manual_work: Parsed the MPS by hand, twice: the first parser asserted a UP bound cannot sit on an integer-marked column and died with AssertionError: ('UP','u___0201',Fraction(1,1)) (digest:385); the rewrite added the comment 'Avoid reliance on disputed default marker upper bounds' (digest:466).

Established the removable scope over all 3872 columns by hand - exactly one x<=480y row, one or three y<=u rows, RHS 0, no objective term, continuous nonnegative y - and then the capacity witnesses a_x*M+mandatory=B (digest evals 'Verifying auxiliary projection scope', 'Certifying activation bounds').
Wrote output/model.mps (462,658 bytes) with a bespoke exact-decimal formatter and 12-character numeric fields, then re-parsed it to compare against the intended model object before committing.

Wrote an independent 7907-byte verify.py plus a 387,988-byte audit.json: 512 capacity identities, 3584 exhaustive binary interval cases (whole x intervals, not grid points), full sparse-matrix equality, plus 80 s-paths of length 16, connectivity and exact duplicate-row checks.
17 turns / 336.7 s / 12 eval cells / 40,625 characters of eval code, 2 failed calls (both its own assertions); no kernel framework member was touched (solver-blind baseline).

Text/JSON plumbing: save() writing 'RPA '+version+'\n'+json.dumps and request.json (tools/prepare_test24.py:157-161), the three deep-copy mutations with an undo closure (tools/prepare_test55.py:113-117) and the double-verify determinism check.

Imports 5 sibling preparers, 893 lines: prepare_affine.parse_mps/row_ref, prepare_test40.expression/expr_json/row_fact/sha, prepare_test57.substitute, prepare_test70.SparseBuilder, prepare_test24.split/execute/popmut (tools/prepare_test55.py:6-10).
friction: Failure 1 (readback semantics): the agent's own parser rejected a legal, ubiquitous MPS pattern - every one of the 288 INTORG columns has an explicit UP=1 - and the assertion text was the only diagnostic; inspect-model answers with counts only (docs/API.md:20) and the typed readback is a 1,759,645-byte JSON dump of the whole model, so the agent never used it.

Failure 2 (scope): 'assert len(vs)==1 and len(ls) in (1,2)' died (digest:555) although 768 auxiliaries have one link and 256 have three (digest:571); the agent's incidence hypothesis cost a full extra eval round because no query returns a column's scope or a degree histogram.

The handoff is untyped: audit.json is 387,988 bytes of per-block records and only its block list is read, while every fact the kernel needs - the capacity identity ax*M+mandatory=row.rhs, the sign and lower-bound premises, the 1536 rewritten rows - is re-derived from MPS text in Python (tools/prepare_test55.py:18-55).

The 1024 lifts are bound nowhere: the claim carries inverse:null and the projection is 2848 literal identity pairs per claim, so the lift y=x/480 exists only inside the 3872-entry Return map; mutating it to 1/479 is detected, but only as 'INVALID obligation mismatch: expected Le; obligation 3424' with no claim or step attribution.

Construction cost is pure duplication of text: the format has no shared mapping DAG and no batch records (docs/CURRENT_FORMAT.md:380-381), so each of the 1536 link rows re-expands its own Cases tree and claims 1-2, which differ only in two integer flags, are written out twice, giving 3,772,500 RPA bytes for a proof the kernel discharges with 674,339 work units.
